verses.pali: “Rūpe, bhikkhave, anabhijānaṁ aparijānaṁ avirājayaṁ appajahaṁ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya.
verses.english: “Mendicants, without directly knowing and completely understanding sights …

verses.pali: dhamme anabhijānaṁ aparijānaṁ avirājayaṁ appajahaṁ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya.
verses.english: ideas, without dispassion for them and giving them up, you can’t end suffering.

verses.pali: Rūpe ca kho, bhikkhave, abhijānaṁ parijānaṁ virājayaṁ pajahaṁ bhabbo dukkhakkhayāya.
verses.english: By directly knowing and completely understanding sights …

verses.pali: dhamme abhijānaṁ parijānaṁ virājayaṁ pajahaṁ bhabbo dukkhakkhayāyā”ti.
verses.english: ideas, having dispassion for them and giving them up, you can end suffering.”
